set.body:
Source: plan phase 5, dependency gate.

Problem:
Replacing Vector[Byte] with scodec.bits.ByteVector requires the dependency in kernel, core, and protocol. Those three modules currently carry only cats and circe. ADR 0001 treats admitting a dependency as an explicit compatibility decision, not an incidental refresh.

Established facts:
- scodec-bits 1.2.4 is ALREADY on the classpath transitively via fs2 for local, ssh, agent, managed, and worker (verified 2026-07-26 from local/dependencyClasspath).
- protocol/dependencyClasspath does not contain it, so kernel/core/protocol would take it directly.
- Therefore the change adds no new version surface to the build, only a new direct edge.

Acceptance:
- A short ADR recording the decision, the no-new-version-surface argument, and the alternative considered (keeping Vector[Byte] and accepting the boxing cost).
- Exact pin added to project/Dependencies.scala consistent with the existing style.
- If the decision is NO, P7.2 is rescoped or dropped and this epic records why.

This is a decision gate, not implementation. It blocks P7.2.
set.title: P7.3: Decide scodec-bits as a kernel/core/protocol dependency
